en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's relax in the sun
Let's dance!
What a great view...

I see...so you're saying that sitting 
plainly in the sun suits plain old me?

No, it's fine to say that to me.
I am plain, after all...

It's plain to see that sitting in the 
sun will make me tan.

That might hurt my cosplaying, 
so I'm going to pass.
Ah, speaking of dancing...

Characters dance in the end credits 
of anime all the time.

I've even memorized a few of them. 
Do you want me to teach you, Shuichi?

While we're at it, how about we record 
it and upload it to a video site?

Really!? 
I sort of like the scenery here, too.

I didn't say anything before because 
I thought I'd get yelled at...

For some reason, this scenery looks 
like it was from an anime or a game!

Maybe because it has a lot of different
elements crammed into one space!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tsumugi looks deep in thought...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Tsumugi's inner thoughts...?
